firm: Two global investment banks (Korea short selling)
what_happened: Short sales placed without first borrowing the shares (KRW 56bn of orders, 2021-2022); FSC penalty surcharges KRW 26.52bn; firms unnamed by the regulator.
control_failure: No pre-trade check that shares were borrowed

firm: Credit Suisse AG and Credit Suisse Singapore

control_failure: No pre-trade check that shares were borrowed

what_happened: Hidden mark-ups charged on transition-management trades; FCA fine GBP 22.9m.

control_failure: Venue operation differed from client disclosures

control_failure: Pricing practice misrepresented to custody clients

firm: Six Korean banks (KIKO FX options to SMEs)

control_failure: Hedge size not checked against the client's real FX exposure; risk disclosure not evidenced
